news.headline: A Chinese Port Could Be a Lifeline for Spain, but Also a Threat
news.summary: Residents say a proposed Chinese car plant in northern Spain will create new jobs. Others say it’s a long-term risk, distilling a debate about the costs and perks of ties to China.

news.headline: Bolsonaro ally denies knowledge of senator’s plan to flee Brazil
